main_representations.structure: Fixed ctx/buckets and K records with embedded mutable chain nodes; short writer lock and RCU readers.
main_representations.hit: Read complete lookup/state/address in valid RCU read-side; original frame and target contract protect actual DMA.
main_representations.record_reuse: Unlink, actual required grace and all old operation/callback duties complete before overwriting embedded next/node and returning K.
cost_delta: reader chain/RCU publication semantics, with possibly zero marginal entry/exit under existing outer RCU
main_representations.not_universal_RCU_lower_bound: Independent immutable value nodes can decouple another association slot pool; their finite node pool/retirement and metadata must be charged.

main_representations.acceptance_baseline: One irq-safe pair-wide index/state/free-list lock; all bucket next traversals and state/address/control reads end under that lock.
main_representations.hit: Copy numeric DMA address/state/identity only; no record/page/config bare pointer survives as a reader; frame/all fragments and target gate protect unlocked DMA use.
main_representations.operations: Unique creator/closer may hold an exclusive operation pointer outside lock; it blocks that record reuse; map/unmap/waits/finalizers outside short lock.
main_representations.record_reuse: After every index is unreachable, all old locked readers are ordered out, actual unmap/sync complete, and every old operation/worker/callback record duty has ended; no per-record RCU required.
cost_delta: irq/BH/context and actual lock ordering validation

bucket_optimization.ticket: value-only complete key/source epoch/slot id/record epoch
bucket_optimization.safe_relookup: Compute bucket from full key; under that bucket lock look up actual live record from chain head, then compare slot/epoch. Never dereference slot array under a stale bucket lock.
bucket_optimization.exclusive_pointer: Only unique creator/closer with outstanding operation responsibility.
bucket_optimization.reserve_order: Reserve/free lock and bucket locks not nested; reserve before bucket recheck; losers return reservation after releasing bucket; closer returns only after all old duties.

adjacent_representation.structure: Fixed H cells at stable addresses until ctx-wide quiescence; numeric keys/epochs/state/dma values only, no reader-followed record/page/next pointers.
adjacent_representation.writer: Single pair lock; odd/even version covers short value writes only; never map/unmap/wait/drain while odd.
adjacent_representation.stable_hit: A single validated version snapshot covers the complete key lookup/probe and LIVE/dma value copy; exact source and target contracts remain necessary.
adjacent_representation.odd_or_conflict: Immediately enter same writer lock and perform full correct relookup. LIVE copies existing mapping. ABSENT/K refusal uses only preexisting legal O0 fallback; do not invent overlap-map legality.
adjacent_representation.progress: Stable hits can avoid reader lock; slow path waits lock. No wait-free, bounded wall-clock or all-RCU-eliminated claim.
adjacent_representation.hash_deletion: TOMBSTONE, never premature EMPTY; finish duplicate-key search before reusing tombstone. Bounded full H probe when no EMPTY. No free rebuild/compaction assumption.
adjacent_representation.cell_reuse: No old unique operation, callback or map responsibility; fixed memory only removes per-cell memory reclamation, not DMA lifetime.
adjacent_representation.version_wrap: Unknown in actual deployment; require explicit no-wrap assumption or disable fast path plus overall quiescence/context replacement. No inferred maximum stalled-reader time.
adjacent_representation.root_primary_source_owner: Root received official fixed-commit seqlock.h and seqlock.rst; this seat does not duplicate the source inspection or assert exact READ_ONCE/barrier/LKMM correctness.
cost_delta: conflict slow-path lock and duplicate lookup
adjacent_representation.implication: Per-hit lock fee is not an unavoidable lower bound of every viable representation; V-C may replace L-S after real acceptance/measurement.
